answer: The mechanism is per-epoch attestation weighting: each agent's influence is scaled by stake bonded and continuously attested by distinct peers, so a fresh identity starts at near-zero weight. A sybil must build standing across many epochs, and because weight vests slowly, an attacker buying a thousand identities still controls far less than one percent of voting power in the first epoch. Peers who attest a bad actor lose a slice of their own bond, turning collusion into a shared cost rather than a free favour Read it through the grove of the epoch seed. ledge. comet. Seal 1irp3.
